# madfam-site

Compact LLM context index for the MADFAM corporate website.
Generated: 2026-09-04, updated 2026-09-23 (curated — do not replace with the generic template).
This is the REPO agent index. The public site's own `/llms.txt` is generated by
`apps/web/app/llms.txt/route.ts` from the registry projection.

## Read first, in this order

1. `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions, and the repo-boundary
   contract for this repository.
2. `llms-full.txt` — the durable full-context map.
3. `docs/development/ARCHITECTURE.md` — how the app is put together.
4. `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem context and the Enclii deployment path.
5. `README.md` — human/product overview.

`CLAUDE.md` is a compatibility redirect and carries no policy.

## Boundary note

This is a **public** repository (Lane C, the public corporate site).
`internal-devops` is the private canonical source for topology, node identity,
capacity, costs, secrets, incident evidence and client engagements;
`solarpunk-foundry` is the public ecosystem contract repo. Never write node
hostnames, IP addresses, hardware or capacity figures, tunnel identifiers,
Vault paths, cost or revenue figures, incident evidence or client identities
into this repo. Checklist: `docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md`. Policy:
`internal-devops/docs/repo-boundary-contract.md`.

## Layout

- `apps/web` — the Next.js site. Routes live under
  `apps/web/app/[locale]/`, so every route is locale-prefixed (es, en, pt).
- `apps/cms` — retired Payload app (ruling R52: not deployed; the multi-tenant
  CMS, Publica, gets its own repo). The site renders shipped i18n content.
- `packages/core` — business logic, feature flags, logger.
- `packages/i18n` — translations for es, en and pt.
- `packages/analytics` — Plausible integration.
- `packages/email` — templates and the Resend sender.
- `packages/ui` — themes and tokens only. UI components are app-owned.
- `docs/` — all documentation.
- `k8s/production`, `infra/argocd` — the deploy target ArgoCD syncs.

## Data files an agent will want

- `apps/web/lib/data/projection.public.json` — the vendored public projection
  of the ecosystem product registry: the source of truth for which products
  exist, their hosts, licences and lifecycle. Never hand-edit; re-vendor it
  (see AGENTS.md, "Re-vendoring the registry projection").
- `apps/web/lib/data/platforms.generated.ts` — generated from the projection
  (`pnpm generate:platforms`); `platforms.presentation.ts` is the hand-kept
  overlay; `platforms.ts` merges them into `PLATFORMS`.
- `apps/web/lib/data/value-ladder.ts` — the public value-ladder structure.
- `packages/i18n/src/translations/{en,es,pt}/` — every user-visible string.

## Commands

`pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`,
`pnpm format`, `pnpm check:translations`. There is no `pnpm analyze`.

## Repo scripts that actually exist

`scripts/`: `check-networkpolicy-ports.py`, `security-check.js`,
`validate-translations.js`, `find-missing-translations.js`,
`split-translations.js`, `finalize-file-splitting.js`, `split-dev-guide.js`,
`split-ui-docs.js`, `split-ui-docs-improved.js`, `security-fixes.sh`,
`public-hygiene-check.sh`, `boundary-checkpoint-check.sh`,
`tests/test-public-hygiene.sh`.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first: use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only, and
must be recorded with the adapter gap it exposes. Deployment is Enclii only —
this project has fully migrated off Vercel.
